item.title: Senior Communications Specialist
item.description: Impactful holistic & operational Senior Comms role. Would consider part time or reduced hours for the right person.
item.job:description:
About The Role
This is a highly impactful role supporting communications within Kinetic IT. This role will straddle both a holistic and operational focus.
Within this role you will play a pivotal position working closely with executives and key internal stakeholders to advise, develop and implement effective communication strategies, plans and collateral to drive engagement and alignment of our workforce. Leverage enterprise messaging channels, platforms and physical engagement opportunities to connect crew to the Kinetic IT purpose, direction, performance, and outcomes, delivering value and raising engagement via corporate communications

Responsibilities will include:
• Develop and deliver the internal communications strategy, connecting crew to business strategy, priorities and key organisational messages.
• Own the annual internal communications agenda, including corporate and account Town Halls, roadshows, corporate updates, crew feedback and key dates.
• Partner with Account Directors and key stakeholders to understand communication needs and build strong, trusted relationships across the business.
• Develop and deliver communications for key projects, initiatives, campaigns and stakeholder activities.
• Create, curate and distribute engaging content across internal communication channels, including Viva Engage, SharePoint and PowerPoint.
• Support corporate and account Town Halls, developing presentations, key messages and supporting communications.
• Partner with senior leaders to strengthen communication capability, consistency and accountability.
• Manage communications during critical incidents, ensuring timely, clear and consistent messaging.
• Collaborate across the business and with external partners on communications, events, marketing and brand initiatives.
• Measure and improve communication impact, using data to assess channel reach, engagement and effectiveness.

What you’ll bring to the table:
• Proven track record in a communications role
• Experience understanding strategy from a business wide lens as well as more operational
• Extensive presentation skills
• Stakeholder management up to C suite level
• Understanding of both strategy and operational comms support
• Systems experience: PowerPoint, Viva Engage, SharePoint, Teams and AI
• Tactical planning
• Project Management
• Resource Coordination

About Kinetic IT
Kinetic IT is a leading Australian IT services provider specialising in Intelligent Workplace, Cloud, Cyber Security, Digital Infrastructure and IT Service Management. We are unlocking the potential of technology to enrich lives of Australian communities.
For more than 25 years, we’ve partnered with some of Australia’s most important organisations, helping them deliver essential services relied upon by our communities including government, critical infrastructure, education, law enforcement, defence, emergency services, utilities, and transport.

Be You, Create the Future
At Kinetic IT, we’re driven by a shared passion for technology, customer success, and community impact.
With over 1,500 talented people working across Australia, we deliver world-class capabilities with a local touch – helping shape the future of tech, here and beyond.
We value individuality and foster an inclusive culture where you’re safe to be your best, real self. We tackle challenges together, celebrate success together, and make sure everyone feels valued, supported, and proud of the work they do.
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome people of all abilities, backgrounds, cultures, and genders. We’re proud to be an Indigenous and Veteran-friendly employer.

The Kinetic IT Difference
• Growth-focused culture – Formal training, mentoring, vendor exam support, communities of practice and regular development reviews.
• Advance your career – Access new roles via our internal ‘Opportunity Marketplace’ careers hub.
• Flex your work – Hybrid options, flexible hours, mobility and part-time roles (customer needs permitting).
• Celebrate together – Social events, cultural celebrations, end-of-year functions and more.
• Wellbeing matters – Health and wellness resources, tailored leave and support options and EAP access.
• Other Perks- Access to our employee discounts platform, discounted gym membership and more.

How To Apply
Work with us as we bring technology to life. Apply today or send your CV direct to careers@kineticit.com.au.
You can learn more about our culture and crew online at https://kineticit.com.au/work-with-us/careers-at-kit/.

item.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
item.description: Own ServiceNow Vulnerability Management for a key customer—shape workflows, solve real problems and turn your SecOps expertise into impact.
item.job:description:
Join Kinetic IT’s national Service Integration team and take ownership of embedded BAU support for a key customer’s ServiceNow Vulnerability Management capability. Working remotely and onsite with the customer, you will be a trusted ServiceNow specialist who connects platform expertise with real operational and security outcomes.

This is a hands-on opportunity to shape and improve vulnerability workflows across risk-based prioritisation, ownership, ageing, exception tracking, remediation coordination and operational reporting.

You will troubleshoot existing and new security-tool integrations, validate requirements directly with stakeholders, and deliver minor development, configuration, defect remediation and enhancements. To also guide UAT, release and change activities, stabilise released integrations and modules, and influence backlog refinement and the development pipeline.

About You

As a Senior ServiceNow Developer, you will enjoy working closely with customers and using your expertise to create practical improvements. You are proactive, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership in a visible role where your work makes a genuine impact.

Skills and experience we will be seeking:

  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response/Vulnerability Management and Security Operations (SecOps).
  • Must hold current ServiceNow CAD, CIS -Data Foundations, CIS – Vulnerability Response and CIS – Security Incident Response certifications.
  • Proven experience providing BAU ServiceNow platform support, including minor development, configuration, workflow enhancements and defect remediation.
  • Strong stakeholder-facing experience, with the ability to validate requirements, communicate technical concepts clearly and build trusted customer relationships.
  • Strong integration troubleshooting capability, ideally across ServiceNow and security tools.
  • Experience producing operational reporting and supporting vulnerability remediation activities.

Kinetic IT is a leading Australian IT services provider specialising in Intelligent Workplace, Cloud, Cyber Security, Digital Infrastructure and IT Service Management. We are unlocking the potential of technology to enrich lives of Australian communities.

The Kinetic IT Difference

  • Growth-focused culture – Formal training, mentoring, vendor exam support, communities of practice and regular development reviews.

  • Celebrate together – Social events, cultural celebrations, end-of-year functions, DEI belonging events and more.
  • Wellbeing matters – Health and wellness resources and events, free skin and health checks, free flu shots, tailored leave and support options, free and confidential EAP and access to Fitness Passport.

item.title: Expressions Of Interest - Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples
item.description: We’re proud to support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples with meaningful opportunities to build IT careers.
item.job:category: Service Desk & IT Support,Programme & Project Management,Cyber Security,Engineering – Hardware,Engineering – Network,Engineering – Software,Networks & Systems Administration,Engineering - Security,Service Management
item.job:description:
Begin your IT journey or take the next step in your career with Kinetic IT—where your story and culture are valued.

Kinetic IT invites Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to express interest in our Entry-level and IT positions, available across Melbourne (Narrm), Sydney (Gadigal Land), Canberra (Ngunnawal Country), Perth (Boorloo), and Brisbane (Turrbal/Jagera Country).

We are committed to creating a workplace where First Nations peoples feel safe, respected, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Guided by our Reconciliation Action Plan, we actively support the growth and representation of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander crew within our team.

  • Your unique experiences and perspectives are valued. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement—your lived experience and community knowledge matter.
  • Cultural safety and inclusion are at the heart of our workplace. We value individuality and foster an inclusive culture where you’re safe to be your best, real self. We offer flexible work arrangements (customer needs permitting), cultural celebrations, and opportunities to participate in cultural events and learning.
  • We celebrate and honour Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultures, histories, and contributions. Our team is dedicated to ongoing learning, truth-telling, and meaningful action on our journey toward reconciliation.

Our opportunities:

Service Desk/Customer Service Roles

These roles are ideal for those looking to start a career in IT and do not require any prior experience or qualifications.

The role will provide:

  • Comprehensive training
  • A supportive team environment and mentoring
  • Opportunities to upskill into more specialised technical roles

Specialist IT Roles

Individuals with prior experience in IT are invited to explore our specialist roles including:

  • Systems and Networking
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud Services
  • IT Project Support and Delivery
  • Service Management

How to Apply

We welcome Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to join us as we work together to bring technology to life!

If you're interested in working with a team that values diversity and inclusion, apply below or send your CV directly to careers@kineticit.com.au.

Discover more about our culture and the Kinetic IT crew online at kineticit.com.au.

This is an equal opportunity measure under s51 of the Equal Opportunity Act 1984 (WA) and s8(1) of the Racial Discrimination Act 1975 (Cth).
